rafa loop — start a plan; stop, pause, resume, show and list its sessions

Usage:
  rafa loop <action> [args] [flags]
  rafa loop <action> --help   arguments, flags, examples

Actions:
  start    run a plan task by task, then wrap up, open the PR and wait for CI 🪙
  stop     stop a running session now, the task it is running marked [BLOCKED]
  pause    pause a running session once the task it is running ends
  resume   resume a paused session from its next task
  status   show a session: its state, tasks done over total and a rough ETA
  list     list the running sessions, with the tasks done in each plan

Examples:
  rafa loop start --plan=.rafa/plans/PLAN-my-feature.md
      Runs the plan from its first open task, then opens the PR and waits on its
      checks.
  rafa loop stop
      Stops the session running on the branch checked out here, marking its
      running task [BLOCKED].
